    # Construct DP groups: ranks with equal (rank % (world_size // 4)) form a group
    num_groups = max(1, world_size // 4)
    groups = [[r for r in range(world_size) if r % num_groups == s] for s in range(num_groups)]

        layer_grads = grads[base:base + 6]
        
        # Concatenate the 6 parameters of this layer into a single flat buffer
        flat = torch.cat([t.reshape(-1) for t in layer_grads])

        offset = 0
        for t in layer_grads:

            outs.append(reduced[offset:offset + n].view(t.shape))
